passages.title: 품질 불량률 개선 보고 메일
passages.passage:
From: Won-jin Seo, Plant Manager
To: Operations Leadership
Subject: Q3 Defect Rate — Below 1 Percent for the First Time

Dear all,

I am pleased to report that the assembly line defect rate fell to 0.8 percent in the third quarter, down from 2.1 percent a year ago and below our 1 percent target for the first time.

Three changes drove the improvement. First, the camera inspection added in March now catches surface flaws before final assembly. Second, rotating workers between stations every two hours reduced repetitive-task errors in the afternoon shift. Third, our two main component suppliers agreed to pre-ship samples for testing, cutting incoming defects by half.

Warranty claims should decline over the next two quarters as newer units reach customers. I propose we share this approach with the Hanover plant, where defect rates remain near 2 percent. My team can host their engineers for a week in November.

Best regards,
Won-jin Seo

questions.q: What milestone does the email report?
choices: The defect rate fell below the 1 percent target
questions.exKo: 불량률이 0.8%로 처음으로 1% 목표를 하회했다는 보고입니다.

questions.q: How did worker rotation help?
questions.exKo: 2시간마다 작업대를 바꿔 반복 작업 오류를 줄였습니다.

questions.q: What does Mr. Seo propose?
choices: Hosting Hanover engineers to share the approach
questions.exKo: 불량률이 높은 Hanover 공장 엔지니어들을 초청해 노하우를 공유하자고 제안합니다.

passages.title: 잡지 광고 게재 제안 메일
passages.passage:
From: Ad Sales, Trade & Freight Monthly
To: Marketing Director, Corvus Shipping
Subject: Feature Issue on Port Automation — Advertising Opportunity

Dear Director,

Our April issue will feature a 12-page special report on port automation, a topic your company helped shape with last year's terminal project. We expect this issue to reach 40 percent more readers than usual, as it will be distributed at the Global Ports Expo in addition to our 28,000 subscribers.

We are offering three placements: a full page opposite the report's opening ($4,800), a half page within the report ($2,900), and a sponsored case study written with our editorial team (2 pages, $7,500, limited to two sponsors).

The case study option includes a video version for our website and social channels. Booking closes March 5, and materials are due March 15. May I call this week to discuss which format fits your goals?

Best regards,
Helen Cho, Advertising Manager

questions.q: Why will the April issue reach more readers?
choices: It will also be distributed at an expo
questions.exKo: 정기 구독자 외에 Global Ports Expo에서도 배포되기 때문입니다.

questions.q: What is special about the case study option?
choices: It includes a video version and is limited to two sponsors
questions.exKo: 웹·소셜용 영상이 포함되며 두 개 업체로 한정됩니다.

questions.q: When are advertising materials due?
questions.exKo: materials are due March 15라고 명시되어 있습니다.

passages.title: 겸직 신고 제도 안내 공지
passages.passage:
OUTSIDE WORK DISCLOSURE — POLICY REMINDER

Employees may hold outside jobs or run side businesses, provided they disclose them through the ethics portal and the activity meets three conditions: it must not compete with our business, must not use company time, equipment, or information, and must not interfere with job performance.

Disclosures are reviewed within ten business days, and approval is valid for one year. Renewals take five minutes if nothing has changed. Common approved examples include weekend teaching, family shops, and creative work; requests involving clients, suppliers, or competitors are generally declined.

Last year, 96 percent of disclosures were approved as submitted. Failing to disclose, however, is treated as a serious policy violation even if the work itself would have been approved. If you are unsure whether an activity counts, submit it anyway — the review costs nothing.

Ethics Office

questions.q: What must employees do about outside work?
choices: Disclose it through the ethics portal
questions.exKo: 겸직은 윤리 포털을 통해 신고해야 합니다.

questions.q: Which requests are generally declined?
choices: Those involving clients, suppliers, or competitors
questions.exKo: 고객사·공급사·경쟁사와 관련된 활동은 대체로 승인되지 않습니다.

questions.q: What is emphasized about failing to disclose?
choices: It is serious even if the work was approvable
It leads to a warning only
questions.exKo: 승인 가능했던 일이라도 신고하지 않으면 중대한 위반으로 처리됩니다.

passages.title: 우수 고객 응대 사례 포상 공지
passages.passage:
SERVICE STAR AWARDS — NOMINATIONS OPEN

Nominations are open for this quarter's Service Star Awards, recognizing colleagues who turned a difficult customer situation into a success story. Anyone may nominate anyone, including themselves; managers' approval is not required.

A nomination needs three things: what the customer needed, what the colleague did beyond standard procedure, and the result — ideally with numbers or a customer quote. The panel selects five winners, each receiving two extra vacation days and a feature in the company newsletter.

Past winners include a technician who drove a replacement part to a hospital on a Sunday, and a billing agent whose plain-language letter template cut repeat complaints by 40 percent and was adopted company-wide.

Submit by the 20th on the recognition portal. Winners are announced at the town hall on the 28th.

Customer Experience Team

questions.q: What do nominations need to include?
choices: The need, the action beyond procedure, and the result
questions.exKo: 고객의 요구, 표준 절차를 넘어선 행동, 결과 세 가지가 필요합니다.

questions.q: What do winners receive?
choices: Two extra vacation days and a newsletter feature
questions.exKo: 휴가 2일과 사보 소개가 부상입니다.

questions.q: What did the billing agent's template achieve?
choices: It cut repeat complaints by 40 percent
questions.exKo: 쉬운 언어로 쓴 안내문이 반복 불만을 40% 줄여 전사에 도입되었습니다.

passages.title: 다국어 번역 구독 서비스 광고
passages.passage:
LINGOBRIDGE — YOUR DOCUMENTS, EVERY LANGUAGE, EVERY TIME

Expanding abroad shouldn't mean waiting a week for a translated contract. LingoBridge combines professional translators with smart technology to deliver business documents in 30 languages — contracts in 48 hours, marketing copy in 24, emails in 4.

Every translation is reviewed by a second linguist, and your company glossary keeps product names and terms consistent across every document. Legal and technical texts are matched to translators with field experience.

Subscriptions start at $199 a month for 20,000 words, sharable across your whole team, with unused words rolling over one month. Rush delivery, certified translations, and website localization are available as add-ons. Try your first 2,000 words free at lingobridge.com.

questions.q: How fast are contracts translated?
questions.exKo: 계약서는 48시간 내 번역됩니다.

questions.q: What keeps terminology consistent?
questions.exKo: 회사 용어집이 제품명과 용어를 일관되게 유지합니다.

questions.q: What happens to unused words?
questions.exKo: unused words rolling over one month라고 안내합니다.

passages.title: 산업 안전화 신제품 광고
passages.passage:
STRIDEGUARD X2 — SAFETY BOOTS BUILT FOR 12-HOUR SHIFTS

Steel toes shouldn't mean sore feet. The new StrideGuard X2 pairs a composite safety toe — 40 percent lighter than steel — with cushioning developed for marathon shoes, because warehouse workers walk up to 15 kilometers a shift.

The slip-tested sole grips wet concrete and oil-coated floors, and the breathable liner keeps feet dry through summer shifts. Electrical hazard protection comes standard, and the X2 meets all major international safety certifications.

Companies ordering 50 pairs or more get free on-site fitting days and a 12-month wear guarantee — if any pair wears out within a year of normal use, we replace it free. Request trial pairs for your safety committee at strideguard.com/business.

questions.q: Why does the ad mention marathon shoes?
choices: The cushioning comes from running shoe development
questions.exKo: 하루 15km를 걷는 작업자를 위해 마라톤화 쿠션 기술을 적용했습니다.

questions.q: What is the composite toe's advantage over steel?
questions.exKo: 복합 소재 토캡은 강철보다 40% 가볍습니다.

questions.q: What does the 12-month guarantee cover?
choices: Free replacement if boots wear out in a year
questions.exKo: 정상 사용 중 1년 내 마모되면 무상 교체합니다.

passages.title: 심야 버스 노선 부활 기사
passages.passage:
GRANVILLE — Night bus service returns to Granville next month after a six-year absence, with two routes running hourly between midnight and 5 a.m. The city council approved the service after a coalition of hospitals, hotels, and logistics firms documented that 4,000 residents work overnight shifts with no transit option.

Employers are sharing the cost: twelve companies will buy discounted monthly passes in bulk for night-shift staff, covering about a third of operating expenses. The transit authority projects the routes will break even within two years if ridership follows survey estimates.

Drivers for the night routes volunteered from the day roster, attracted by a 15 percent shift premium. Service begins the first Monday of next month; real-time tracking will be available in the city transit app from day one.

questions.q: Why was night bus service approved?
choices: Thousands of night workers had no transit option
questions.exKo: 야간 근무자 4천 명에게 대중교통이 없다는 자료가 근거가 되었습니다.

questions.q: How are employers contributing?
choices: Buying discounted passes in bulk for staff
questions.exKo: 12개 기업이 직원용 할인 정기권을 대량 구매해 비용 3분의 1을 부담합니다.

questions.q: Why did drivers volunteer for night routes?
questions.exKo: 15% 야간 수당이 유인이 되었습니다.

passages.title: 포장재 절감 실험 기사
passages.passage:
COMMERCE WATCH — Online grocer FreshCrate cut packaging waste 30 percent in a six-month trial by asking customers a single question at checkout: "Reuse your last delivery box?" Customers who agreed left their empty crate out for the driver, who exchanged it for the full one.

About 60 percent of customers opted in, higher than the 35 percent the company projected. Crates survive an average of nine round trips before recycling. The company saves an estimated $0.42 per delivery, part of which funds a small discount for participating customers.

The trial exposed challenges: crates returned dirty must be washed, adding a depot step, and apartment customers participate at half the rate of house dwellers because storing crates is harder. FreshCrate will expand the program to all delivery zones in March and is testing a folding crate for small orders.

questions.q: How did FreshCrate cut packaging waste?
questions.exKo: 빈 상자를 회수해 재사용하는 방식으로 포장 폐기물을 30% 줄였습니다.

questions.q: How did actual participation compare with projections?
choices: It was much higher than projected
questions.exKo: 예상 35%를 크게 웃도는 60%가 참여했습니다.

questions.q: Why do apartment customers participate less?
choices: Storing crates is harder for them
questions.exKo: 아파트에서는 상자 보관이 어려워 참여율이 절반에 그칩니다.

passages.title: 워크숍 강사 섭외 문자
passages.passage:
Julie Winter (10:15 A.M.)
Our negotiation workshop trainer just canceled for the 22nd — family emergency. We have 30 people registered.

Oscar Lund (10:18 A.M.)
Ouch. Options?

Julie Winter (10:19 A.M.)
Three: postpone to next month, find a replacement trainer, or run it internally — Dana from Sales taught this at her old company.

Oscar Lund (10:22 A.M.)
Postponing kills momentum, and outside trainers need weeks of lead time. What's your read on Dana?

Julie Winter (10:24 A.M.)
She's excellent, and she offered — but she'd want to cut the roleplay section she hasn't run before, making it a half-day.

Oscar Lund (10:26 A.M.)
A strong half-day beats a canceled full day. Book Dana, refund the difference in the course fee, and schedule the roleplay as a follow-up when the original trainer recovers.

Julie Winter (10:27 A.M.)
On it. I'll email attendees the change today.

questions.q: What problem are they solving?
questions.exKo: 협상 워크숍 강사가 취소되어 대응 방안을 논의 중입니다.

questions.q: Why is Dana's version shorter?
choices: She would cut the roleplay section
She is only free half the day
questions.exKo: 진행해 본 적 없는 롤플레이 파트를 빼서 반일 과정이 됩니다.

questions.q: What is decided about the roleplay section?
choices: It becomes a follow-up session later
questions.exKo: 원래 강사가 회복하면 후속 세션으로 진행하기로 합니다.

passages.title: 물류 통관 지연 대응 문자
passages.passage:
Marco Silva (6:05 A.M.)
Customs flagged our container in Rotterdam — random inspection. Adds 3-5 days.

Ina Berg (6:40 A.M.)
That's the spring collection for the Berlin stores. Launch is in 8 days.

Marco Silva (6:42 A.M.)
Right. If inspection takes 3 days we're fine. If 5, we miss the window by a day.

Ina Berg (6:45 A.M.)
Can we split the risk? Air-freight the display samples and bestseller sizes now, let the container follow.

Marco Silva (6:48 A.M.)
Smart. About 800 units by air covers launch weekend. Costs $3,400 extra.

Ina Berg (6:50 A.M.)
Approved — launch weekend drives a third of season sales. Also alert the Berlin store managers so they plan the stockroom for two deliveries.

Marco Silva (6:51 A.M.)
Booking the air shipment now. I'll send both tracking links by noon.

questions.q: What caused the delay?
questions.exKo: 로테르담 세관의 무작위 검사에 걸려 3~5일 지연됩니다.

questions.q: What solution do they choose?
choices: Air-freighting key items while the container follows
questions.exKo: 진열 샘플과 인기 사이즈만 항공으로 먼저 보내기로 합니다.

questions.q: Why does Ms. Berg approve the extra cost?
choices: Launch weekend drives a third of season sales
questions.exKo: 출시 주말 매출이 시즌의 3분의 1이라 지연 손실이 더 크기 때문입니다.
